purpose: Resolve the material objective-and-training uncertainty before spending a scarce experiment on a ranking-aligned loss, after user-normalized BCE regressed relative to the request-context BCE parent. Seek evidence on whether pairwise or listwise objectives improve top-k ordering without harming within-user discrimination in logged implicit-feedback ranking.
query: Within-user implicit-feedback recommendation objectives for a fixed logged-impression candidate set: compare pointwise BCE, RankNet/BPR pairwise loss, and ListNet/listwise top-k losses for optimizing group AUC and nDCG@5; include practical negative-pair construction, weighting for users with variable impression counts, and temporal holdout evaluation.

purpose: Resolve whether the negative screen for simple historical author/item and user-author aggregates should rule out, or instead motivate, a bounded causal sequence representation. Literature is needed to define a leakage-safe and computationally feasible history mechanism before considering an architecture change.
query: Causally truncated sequential user-behavior representations for temporal implicit-feedback recommendation with logged impressions: candidate-conditioned attention or compact sequence pooling versus simple prior user-item/author response aggregates; include leakage-safe feature construction, cold or sparse-history behavior, and evaluation on within-user top-k ranking.
